About

At Elixir, we believe that great brands don’t just exist—they tell a story that captivates, inspires, and moves people to action.

Founded by Rhett Guter and Adam Record, Elixir is built on a shared passion for storytelling, design, and the magic of human connection. We help businesses and creators craft brands that are more than just visuals or marketing tactics—they’re experiences that leave a lasting impact.

Our Expertise

At Elixir, we help brands find their voice, sharpen their identity, and connect with their audiences through thoughtful, strategic design and storytelling. Our expertise includes:

  • Brand Identity & Strategy

    Crafting logos, messaging, and brand systems that define who you are.

  • Websites & Digital Presence

    Designing user-friendly websites that tell your story and convert customers.

  • Marketing & Content Strategy

    Developing campaigns, pitch decks, and messaging that bring brands to life.

  • Creative Direction & Design

    Crafting visuals, packaging, and digital assets that make a statement.

Whether you’re a startup looking to build your brand from the ground up or an established business ready for a fresh perspective, Elixir is here to help you stand out, connect, and grow.

Let’s craft something unforgettable.

Meet the Team

Rhett GuterThe Storyteller & Strategist

A performer, magician, and storyteller at heart, Rhett has spent years mastering the art of audience engagement. With a deep understanding of what makes a message stick, he brings a strategic approach to branding and marketing—helping businesses captivate the right people at the right time. Whether it’s crafting compelling narratives, shaping marketing strategies, or ensuring every brand touchpoint resonates, Rhett makes sure your story is unforgettable.

Adam RecordThe Artist & Brand Builder

A musician, illustrator, and brand designer, Adam has built a career around bringing ideas to life. With an instinct for visual storytelling and a passion for helping businesses grow, he blends artistry with strategy to create brands that feel authentic, distinctive, and powerful. From designing logos and websites to shaping full-scale brand identities, Adam ensures every detail is crafted with purpose and meaning.

Let’s tell your story the right way—boldly, beautifully, and authentically.
